description: Plan 14's system_bodies, body_detail and body_events messages, pinned from both languages, every number at the full precision of its f64, since the server parses floats exactly (serde_json's float_roundtrip, ruling 64.7): the Rust wire-form tests of hyperion-protocol read this file and require every message to round-trip exactly, and @hyperion/protocol's tests decode it. system_bodies_response is the vertical slice's: one Sun-like star, its zone, and two planets whose label, moons and rings are not_modelled, with the system's belts and halo not_modelled; the Earth carries the rotation, figure and photometry sections (P14.T46.f, T47.d, illustrative values), and the giant keeps the form of a server before them, without the three keys. system_bodies_populated exercises every kind, state and section state a later generator version gives, its ring with its plane's normal, the pole at the slice Earth's obliquity, 0.409 rad, turned from its planet's orbit normal about its ascending node (P14.T56.a; the client's tests remove it for an older server's), and is shapes, not a generator's output: which sections a destroyed, unbound or not-yet-formed body keeps is P14.T28's and T30's to say. body_events_response has no events, since BodyEventDto has no variant before P14.T31. The body_detail answers are one Earth at three detail levels and the slice's Jupiter: the Earth's full record carries its surface (P14.T35.e, illustrative values), with its condensates (P14.T54.a, illustrative values: its ocean and its ice, the ice's trapped area sent and the ocean's absent) and its crust in the server's form (P14.T54.a), the sim's present Earth's (CrustComposition::derive's example: a basalt lid over a buried ultramafic primary crust, with granite continents, mantle_redox_iw 3.55), whose melt area is 0, and an envelope not_applicable, its mass_and_orbit record withholds both, and its contact record keeps the form of a server before P14.T35.e, with no envelope key; the Jupiter's record is its list entry with its surface not_applicable and its envelope ok (illustrative values). Two more full records carry P14.T54.a's crust as the server sends it, the rest of each illustrative but where a figure is cited: body_detail_lava_world, a locked lava world, a small rocky planet locked 1:1 at 0.048 au with the size, mass, mean surface temperature (1,238.7 K), equator-pole and day-night contrasts and crust of a golden system's (close_binary's 42002cb200000009.e201, generator version 22), airless, its crust's melt area, its dayside pool, above 0, with no silicate_vapour key; and body_detail_titan, a Titan, a regular moon of a Saturn the slice does not list, its surface at the Huygens site's measured 93.65 K and 1,467 hPa (Fulchignoni et al. 2005), its air N2 with the measured 5.65% of CH4 by mole near the surface (Niemann et al. 2010), its lakes a ch4_c2h6_n2 liquid condensate on 1% of the surface, inside the measured 0.85-1.07% (Hayes 2016), and an H2O lid whose melt area is 0 over no melted-rock crust, the server's form for a regular icy moon whose rock never melted, as Titan's moment of inertia factor, about 0.34, implies incomplete differentiation (Iess et al. 2010). @hyperion/protocol's planetary.test.ts cites each measured figure in full.
